sequence: delta=(index%24)*0.05; pan/resume translate lon; zoom contracts all four geographic limits; same as prior workload, repeated five times
cold: Fresh process, cleared projected geometry cache, fresh GPU context; first paint measured separately, no p95 claim with N=5
warm: Explicit 24-frame phase warm-up then 120 measured frames; persistent caches remain bounded at original limits; report hit/miss/upload deltas for every frame
selection: Retain every run, no rejection based on timing or CPU load; report median,p95,population variance per run and pooled
gc: Enabled with existing thresholds, record counts/statistics, no forced collection between measured frames
conditions: CPU model/count/frequency, affinity, process priority, CPU load before/after, RSS, Python/NumPy, GL vendor/device/driver, dimensions/DPI, workload/source hashes; unknown thermals/VRAM marked unknown
